STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_07407_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_07407_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_07407 (
    input           clk,        
    input           rst_n,      
    input           ena,        
    input           trig,       
    input   [ 7:0]  Thsync,     
    input   [15:0]  Thlen,      
    output  reg     hsync,      
    output  reg     vsync,      
    output          daten       
);

    reg [15:0] cnt_dur, cnt_len;
    wire [16:0] cnt_dur_nxt, cnt_len_nxt;
    wire        cnt_dur_done, cnt_len_done;
    reg [2:0]   cnt_hsync;
    reg         done;
    reg         trig_latch;
    reg         sync;

    parameter Thsynccnt = 3;

    reg [2:0]  state;
    parameter IDLE_S = 3'b001;
    parameter SYNC_S = 3'b010;
    parameter LEN_S  = 3'b100;

    assign cnt_dur_nxt  = {1'b0, cnt_dur} - 1'b1;
    assign cnt_dur_done = cnt_dur_nxt[16];

    assign cnt_len_nxt  = {1'b0, cnt_len} - 1'b1;
    assign cnt_len_done = cnt_len_nxt[16];

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
        if (!rst_n)
            trig_latch <= 1'b0;
        else if (trig)
            trig_latch <= 1'b1;
        else if (ena)
            trig_latch <= 1'b0;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
    begin
        if (!rst_n)
        begin
            state   <= IDLE_S;
            cnt_dur <= 16'h0;
            cnt_len <= 16'b0;
            sync    <= 1'b0;
            done    <= 1'b0;
        end
        else if (ena)
        begin
            cnt_dur <= cnt_dur_nxt[15:0];
            cnt_len <= cnt_len_nxt[15:0];
            done    <= 1'b0;

            case(state)
                IDLE_S:
                begin
                    if (trig_latch)
                    begin
                        state   <= SYNC_S;
                        cnt_dur <= Thsync;
                        cnt_len <= Thlen;

                        sync    <= 1'b1;
                    end
                end

                SYNC_S:
                begin
                    if (cnt_dur_done)
                    begin
                        state <= LEN_S;
                        sync  <= 1'b0;
                    end
                end

                LEN_S:
                begin
                    if (~|cnt_hsync)
                        state   <= IDLE_S;
                    else if (cnt_len_done)
                    begin
                        state   <= SYNC_S;
                        cnt_dur <= Thsync;
                        cnt_len <= Thlen;

                        sync    <= 1'b1;
                        done    <= 1'b1;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
        if (!rst_n)
            cnt_hsync <= 3'd0;
        else if (trig)
            cnt_hsync <= Thsynccnt;
        else if (ena & done)
            cnt_hsync <= cnt_hsync - 1'b1;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
        if (!rst_n)
            hsync <= 1'b0;
        else
            hsync <= sync;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
        if (!rst_n)
            vsync <= 1'b0;
        else if (done & (cnt_hsync == Thsynccnt))
            vsync <= 1'b1;
        else if (done & (cnt_hsync == Thsynccnt-1))
            vsync <= 1'b0;

    assign daten = 1'b0;

endmodule
